classes.bug: incorrect deterministic behavior or testable defect
classes.documentation: operator guide, report, or continuation gap
classes.governance: approval, authority, audit, or invariant concern
classes.operator_workflow: review, rollback, approval, or triage workflow issue
classes.performance: latency, scale, resource, or throughput issue
classes.provenance: missing, weak, or unclear source trace
classes.reasoning: weak inference, synthesis, contradiction handling, or uncertainty behavior
classes.replay: replay ordering, consolidation review, or reproducibility issue
classes.retrieval: missed, irrelevant, or poorly ranked evidence

priorities.P0: safety invariant breach or hidden authority risk
priorities.P1: blocks operational workflow or corrupts evidence
